reviewMethod: Read-only installed source/diff, regression and governing contract inspection; independent source-digest audit of the parent-executed owner admission receipt. No independent Rust execution claimed.

reviewObservations.observation: Ordinary checked_json uses the same traversal with unchanged initial depth zero, maximum depth128 and100000 node limits; byte limits are added only to the separate private bounded entry point.

raw.len() counts UTF8 bytes including whitespace before parsing. Root begins at depth1; each object/array/scalar value increments once; object names do not increment node count. Zero depth/node capacity and exact/one-over boundaries are covered by the appended source regressions.

RawObject retains entries until decoded keys are compared, including escaped aliases of the same member name. Nested duplicate examples assert WFT-JSON-DUPLICATE; malformed JSON asserts WFT-INPUT. Final Value construction occurs only after complete inspection.
The actual owner serde_json dependency retains arbitrary_precision and raw_value features; the traversal never deliberately converts raw unknown numeric tokens through f64.

Contract explicitly permits input-byte-bounded raw container allocations before recursive node admission and excludes constant-memory/instruction-bound claims. The private helper has no runtime cell caller and grants no domain, policy, authority or release admission.

scope: Parameterized duplicate-preserving JSON transport inspection foundation only. No runtime cell format/domain/outcome checking, authenticated cut, streaming release, native qualification or backend acceptance is established.
